title: United States Federal AI Governance: NIST AI RMF 1.0, AI 600-1, and Executive Order Trajectory (2023-2026)
stage_label: Revocation of EO 14110 & Deregulatory Federal Pivot (2025)

institutional_author.name: Executive Office of the President of the United States

summary: Formal revocation of Biden-era Executive Order 14110 (Oct 2023) on January 20, 2025, replaced by 'Removing Barriers to American Leadership in Artificial Intelligence'; eliminates federal DPA safety-reporting mandates while NIST AI RMF persists as a voluntary enterprise benchmark alongside FTC Section 5 enforcement.
